Cost category Key cost drivers and considerations → As people are vaccinated: the additional personnel to support use of the systems, including Human resources training, management, etc. → Depending on the licensing model associated with any digital solution, the additional licences IT licensing that may need to be purchased as the number of operators or amount of data increases, or additional IT infrastructure is needed → As data volume and number of system users grows, the scaling up of the capacity of the digital IT scalability solution to provide the necessary storage and processing power Sustained operations → Consistent training of new staff when staff leave, and refresher training for existing staff – Refresher training with content updates made as the context changes → Monitoring and evaluation of DDCC:VS implementation practices and processes, with Adaptive management application of learnings → Continued messaging, with consideration of accessibility needs Communication → Continued help desk or customer service technology support for users of the DDCC:VS → Fixing bugs, adding features, maintaining customizations, releasing updates, and hardware Technology maintenance maintenance and replacement 8.4. Additional resources to support implementation Additional resources that can be leveraged to support the implementation of DDCC:VS include examples of implementations already deployed, additional technical specifications for specific use cases, and general guidance on implementing digital health solutions. Note that the following is a non- exhaustive list of examples. WHO will be documenting in a clearinghouse software solutions that are consistent with the DDCC:VS specifications.
